3. Conduct training on artificial intelligence literacy for education managers. Design training courses focused on the application strategies and management capabilities of artificial intelligence for education managers. Organize training sessions for education bureau directors and principals. Promote education managers to adapt to the changes brought by new technologies, actively utilize artificial intelligence technology to support scientific decision-making, optimize resource allocation, drive educational reform, and enhance the level of intelligent governance in education. (Responsible unit: Provincial Department of Education)

(V) Deepen research and international exchange in artificial intelligence education practice
14. Deepen the practice research of "Artificial Intelligence + Education." Establish the Zhejiang Province "Artificial Intelligence + Education" industry-university-research alliance, jointly build artificial intelligence education research and development centers, laboratories, training bases, etc., and break through key technological bottlenecks. Issue an action plan for enhancing the quality of higher education teaching and innovation empowered by artificial intelligence, compile guidelines for the application of generative artificial intelligence in primary and secondary schools and higher education institutions, release key research topics in specific scenarios, and deepen application research; establish 6 artificial intelligence education bases for primary and secondary schools designated by the Ministry of Education and 100 provincial pilot schools for artificial intelligence education applications, cultivate 10 pilot areas for educational reform supported by artificial intelligence, and 50 pilot schools. (Responsible units: Provincial Department of Education, Provincial Department of Science and Technology)

15. Strengthen international exchange and cooperation in artificial intelligence education. Actively host internationally influential conferences on artificial intelligence education, build platforms for academic exchange and innovation in artificial intelligence education, and promote the exchange and participation of international experts and scholars. Engage in various forms of cooperation with relevant international organizations and overseas educational institutions, including mutual visits of teachers and students in the field of artificial intelligence, academic discussions, and joint curriculum development.
